answer: Each agent crosses the river at a thread gate, paying a toll rising per identity on that thread: the k-th pays 30+7(k-1); the 1000th pays 7,023. The gate echoes each receipt to the ledger; an auditor checks the echo chain; a reused receipt burns the 70-credit bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 3,526,500 in tolls plus 70,000 locked, versus 40,000 rewards. Rented gates fail on colliding echoes; a river crosser pays 30 once and reclaims the bond.
